text:
Japan’s inflation-adjusted, PPP-consistent GDP per capita rose about twelvefold from 1950 to 2016 (roughly 11–14× in the Maddison/PWT series). In 1990 international dollars that is about $1,900 in 1950 versus the low-to-mid $20,000s by the 2010s, and the same ratio appears after rescaling both years onto 2011 prices. A fivefold rise fits the path only to around 1970, and a twentyfold rise shows up only when a 1950 level in 1990 dollars is divided by a 2016 level in a later PPP dollar.

CONFIDENCE: 80
